content_sections.heading: CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Recruitment 2026 covers a total of 60 vacancies across two disciplines, distributed by category as shown below. CSL has reserved the right to increase or decrease the number of seats, or not fill up any vacancy, as per its requirement. Candidates currently working as Ship Draftsman Trainees on the rolls of CSL as on the date of this notification are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The diploma must be from a University, Institute or Examination Board recognised by AICTE, or an appropriate statutory, State or Central authority. Candidates with equivalent qualifications must submit an Equivalency Certificate; without it, their application will not be considered. Candidates without the prescribed diploma qualification but holding higher qualifications such as B.Tech or M.Sc. are not eligible and will not be considered, even if they otherwise appear qualified. The upper age limit is 25 years as on 04 September 2026, meaning applicants should be born on or after 05 September 2001. Age relaxation is available as follows: Age relaxation applies only to seats reserved for the respective category. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

rows.educational_qualification: Pass in SSLC, plus a 3-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a State Board of Technical Education with a minimum of 60% marks, with an aptitude for draftsmanship and proficiency in CAD.
Pass in SSLC, plus a 3-year Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a State Board of Technical Education with a minimum of 60% marks, with an aptitude for draftsmanship and proficiency in CAD.

content_sections.heading: CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo a two-year training period and will be paid a monthly stipend, along with eligibility for extra hours of work beyond normal work hours. There will be a performance evaluation at the end of the first year, and the second year of training will be given only to successful candidates. Depending on organisational requirements, vacancy availability and individual performance, successful trainees may be considered for contractual posts for a period of 5 years, at CSL's discretion. The notification does not specify a regular/permanent appointment at the end of training, and CSL clarifies that it is not liable for regular appointment of trainees during or after the two-year training period.

content_sections.heading: CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online using Debit Card, Credit Card or Internet Banking between 19 August 2026 and 04 September 2026. No other mode of payment is accepted, and no refund is given after successful submission or withdrawal of an application. Candidates for whom the fee is applicable will not be considered unless the fee is received.

content_sections.heading: CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Recruitment 2026 is entirely through a Practical Test carrying 100 marks. Candidates are required to prepare a drawing using CAD software, and the test will be held at CSL, Kochi. Only candidates who clear certificate verification will be permitted to appear for the Practical Test, which will be scheduled on a later date. The rank list for each discipline will be prepared based on marks scored in the practical test among candidates meeting the eligibility requirements; in case of a tie, relative merit will be decided based on seniority in age. CSL may relax the minimum pass mark if the number of qualified candidates is insufficient. The rank list will remain valid for up to 18 months from the date of reporting of the last candidate advised to join, or until a fresh notification is issued for the same post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must apply online through the CSL SAP application portal. No other mode of application submission is accepted. Visit the official website www.cochinshipyard.in and go to the Career page → CSL, Kochi. Go through the User Manual and FAQ published on the career page before filling the application. Complete the One-Time Registration on the SAP Online portal. Fill in the online application form against the applicable post. Upload all required certificates: proof of age, educational qualification, caste certificate (if applicable), and a recent passport-size colour photograph. Pay the applicable application fee online (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking). Review all entries carefully, since changes are not allowed after final submission, and submit the application. Confirm the application status shows "In process" by logging in to My Applications. Retain a soft copy or printout of the online application and note the unique registration number for future reference. The application window is open from 19 August 2026 to 04 September 2026. Applicants are advised to submit well before the last date, since troubleshooting or technical support may not be available in the SAP portal after 4:00 PM on the last date. Applicants should not submit more than one application, and incomplete, withdrawn, or draft-status applications will not be considered. Certificates, application printouts, or fee payments should not be sent by post to CSL.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Cochin Shipyard Limited to fill 60 Ship Draftsman Trainee posts (Mechanical and Electrical disciplines) through Notification No. CSL/P&A/RECTT/TRAINEES/GENERAL/2023/1 dated 18 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 60 vacancies in total: 47 for Ship Draftsman Trainee (Mechanical) and 13 for Ship Draftsman Trainee (Electrical).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 04 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC and hold a 3-year Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (as applicable) from a State Board of Technical Education with a minimum of 60% marks, along with an aptitude for draftsmanship and proficiency in CAD.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 25 years as on 04 September 2026. Age relaxation of 3 years applies to OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates and 5 years to SC/ST candidates for reserved seats.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹300 (non-refundable, plus bank charges) for UR/OBC/EWS candidates. SC/ST candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for CSL Ship Draftsman Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CSL, Kochi) via the SAP application portal, between 19 August 2026 and 04 September 2026.
